description: PLAY-09 (owner play-test 2026-11-27): quest texts and tips must match the enemies that actually spawn. BAL-04/05 cap solo fights at two enemies (SOLO_MAX_ENEMIES), so texts and tips that still spoke of three enemies, or of a third enemy that no longer spawns (murloc, murloc shaman, pillager), are corrected. Text only; enemies unchanged. Guarded by scripts/test_quest_text_counts.cjs.
